text:
jessica: quick heads-up — the site linter scan found ~120 dead anchors/404s across the KB. i'm going to kick off a small sprint to patch the highest-traffic ones (top ~30). who can own batches? :clipboard:

rohan: i can take runtime + serving pages (1-10). will open PRs tomorrow AM.

maureen: onboarding + quickstarts (11-20) — i'll grab images + short snippets, should be 1-2 PRs.

sam: i can do a quick pass on integrations and api reference (21-30), but heads-up: a couple refs need TOC changes, will call out in PR.

jessica: amazing, ty! two quick asks: 1) if you touch frontmatter, don't change slugs unless necessary (breaks shortlinks). 2) add an "owner: <name>" line at top of the PR description so we can track handoffs.

rohan: noted. also found a recurring pattern — shortlink redirects failing for staging assets. dropping a ripgrep snippet for anyone who wants to search locally:

```bash
rg "staging-cdn.example.com/.+?/assets" docs/ -n
```

maureen: thanks, useful. do we want to update the linter rule to flag that pattern? could save future churn.

jessica: yes please. if you have a small patch for the linter config, toss it into the same PR as the onboarding fixes and mark it as optional.

docs-bot: scan summary: https://internal-reports.redwood/scan/4315 — 120 findings, severity: low/med mostly, traffic-weighted top 30 attached.

sam: i'll ping @eng-ml about a handful of model-onboarding links that look stale (they're referenced from runtime docs). cc @eng-ml — can you spot-check 3 links in the model onboarding folder when you have a minute?

eng-ml: yup, can do. timeline ~today EOD. i'll post any blockers here.

jessica: perfect. rough timeline: owners open PRs by EOD tomorrow, reviewers pinged, merge during next docs sprint on Thursday. i'll create a tracking GH issue and add the owners.

rohan: PR opened for runtime: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/2123 — includes link fixes + tiny linter tweak. requesting review from @sam and @maureen.

maureen: thanks rohan — reviewing now.

sam: quick note for reviewers: try not to reformat paragraphs in the same PR, just link fixes + alt text updates. keeps diffs small. :pray:

jessica: yep — small focused PRs make rollouts safer. i'll also add a one-off job to the docs retention dashboard to watch for regressions.

maureen: all set from my side on onboarding PRs, opened 2 PRs: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/2124 and /2125. left comments on a couple ambiguous snippets.

jessica: thank you everyone. i'll update the tracking issue and close the loop once merges are in. if anyone needs help rebasing or adding owners, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
